The '''Flare Jacket''' was originally created by a luxury [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] manufacturer to enable flashy entrances, but its potential for tactical use led organizations to commission [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] to produce a more powerful version. This enhanced [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] concealed small charges in its seams that, when triggered, emitted a blinding and stunning flash of light. The burst gave the wearer a few [[Standard second|seconds]] to escape, though the internal power source required several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to recharge between uses.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flare Jacket was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
